tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshim pa drug ldan tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i glu gnas gsum ḍā ki dgyes pa'i taṃ bu ra zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa yi ngo bo/ /rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag tu bzhugs pa/ /smin grol gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'i bka' drin gyis skyong ba'i/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma snying dbus nas dran no/ sh+lau ka gcig po 'di sprul sku kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar mdzad pa'o/ /bde stong zung du 'jug pa ye shes kyi rang gzugs/ /deng 'dir tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod yul du shar ba'i/ /bla ma yi dam dpa' bo ḍā kī yi tshogs bcas/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i glu yi rang sgra la gson cig /a ho sngon bsags bsod nams legs smon gyi mthu yis/ /a ma bdag med mkha' 'gro'i zhal rgyun gyi bdud rtsi/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i bla chen thugs bcud du bzung ba/ /rnam dkar las 'phro sad pa'i mgrin pa ru myang byung / /zab zab gdams pa'i bcud kyis bdag yid ni tshim pas/ /ling ling dga' ba'i gar stabs sgyur ba dang sbrags nas/ /snyan snyan glu yi 'gyur khug dbang med du shor bas/ /ma ma gnas gsum mkha' 'gros ram bu zhig theg dang / bdag mdun gyi dkyil 'khor mchod pas tshim pa/ /ting 'dzin sgyu ma'i rnam pa rol pa las byung ba'i/ /bdag mdun dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes byed kyi thabs mkhas/ /phyi nang gsang ba de nyid mchod tshogs kyi sprin phung / /rgyal sras kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar la 'gran no/ /snying kha'i ting 'dzin sems dpa' bdud rtsis tshim pa/ /snying kha'i dbus su bsti ba'i ye shes kyi lha la/ /zag med bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'di spros pas/ /bde stong nyams kyi zil chen tshad med du rgyas pas/ /dgyes pa'i 'dzum ris dkar po yal med du gsal lo/ /chos skyong srung ma gtor mas tshim pa/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral dang bka' sdod/

/zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug yab yum la sogs pa'i/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho ba liṃ tas tshim pas/ /las bzhi'i phrin las lhun grub rten 'brel de 'grigs so/ /dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo bza' btung gis tshim pa/ dam tshig rgyan gyis mdzes shing rim gnyis kyi lam la/ nam yang mi phyed 'dun pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i bza' bca' btung ba yi tshogs la/ /dgyes dgur rol pa'i dga' ston nyams med du spel lo/ /skye mched kyi lha rnams glu gar rol mos tshim pa/ snyan pa'i glu dang rol mo'i sgra chen ni sgrogs shing / /mdzes pa'i gar gyi rol stabs sna tshogs su sgyur bas/ /skye mched sems dpa' sems ma'i lha tshogs rnams mnyes pas/ /zhal 'dzum sprin dkar phung po lang ling du g.yos so/ /lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs bde bas tshim pa/ dngos dang ye shes smin legs chos 'byung gi dbus su/ /thabs ldan rdo rje rol pa'i rnal 'byor la gzhol bas/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor gdan gsum tshang ba yi lha tshogs/ /'gyur med bde ba'i ngang la g.yo med du gnas so/ /phyi rol yul gyi snang cha ma 'gags pa'i tshul la/ /'di ltar tshim pa drug ldan phun tshogs kyi bkod pa/ /rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa khams 'phro 'du las byung zhing / /de yang rang sems gcig pur snang tshul gyi khyad tsam/ /mthar thug 'jog so bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes/ /'khor 'das kun gyi rnam rol 'char tshul du nges pas/ /gang shar bde stong zung 'jug 'ba' zhig tu snang ba/ /gsang chen zab mo'i khyad chos a la la ho ho/ /e ma yang gcig gson dang skal ldan gyi bu rnams/ /sde snod gsum gyi dgongs don snying po ru dril ba/ /snang ba gsum gyi lam la blo sbyong zhig mdzad nas/ /lam gyi gzhi rtsa brling po thing nges su mdzod cig /dam tshig rnam dag mig gi 'bras bu bzhin bsrung zhing /

/'khor 'das dbyer med lta ba'i srog rtsa de zin nas/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug zab mo'i myur lam la brten nas/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal sa la phebs shig /de tshe sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam gyi dbang gis/ /pha mar gyur pa'i mkha' mnyam 'gro ba 'di kun la/ /mngon mtho nges legs dgos 'dod char bzhin du 'bebs pa'i/ /phan bde'i rtsa lag 'gyur ba'i bkra shis shig zhu 'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni yul tri shod kyi sa'i thig le nya brag rdo rje gdan du skal ldan gyi slob bu brgya dang lnga bcu nga grangs tsam la gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag zab mo slob bshad kyi tshul du spros pa legs par grub pa'i dga' ston gyi tshogs mchod 'bul ba'i tshe rig 'dzin gyi btsun pa ngag dbang legs pas smras pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sga ston ngag dbang legs pa/ tshim pa drug ldan tshogs 'khor gnas gsum ḍā ki dgyes pa'i taṃ bu ra/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
